Weather conditions: air temperature 70 degrees, relative humidity 42 percent, barometer 30.23 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,298 feet, track temperature 95 degrees.

The only time the #4 - 6 TF qualifiers met in the Final at this event was 1992.

In Final rounds Antron Brown "leaves first" 67% of the time.

Brown and Gordon have each won 1 times against the other in prior events and Gordon is 1 - 0 against
Brown in prior final rounds. 

Gordon double steps it and turns on the red light to give Brown the win. 

Brown kept it hooked up and straight down the groove for the win.  Brown wins his 83rd National event
Wally and 67th in Top Fuel.  This is second win this season.
